sources.entry: Miniflux - Minimalist news reader. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/deb/Docker
Miniflux | Minimalist and opinionated feed reader

summary.one_liner: Miniflux is a minimalist, opinionated self-hosted feed reader written in Go that stores its data in PostgreSQL.
summary.what_it_does: Miniflux reads Atom, RSS and JSON Feed sources and supports OPML import/export and URL-based subscription. It fetches full article content with a local Readability parser, and offers custom CSS-selector scraper rules, rewrite rules, and a regex filter for including or excluding articles. The interface includes full-text search (powered by Postgres), categories, bookmarks, public article sharing, favicons, and several themes with keyboard shortcuts. Privacy features include stripping tracking parameters, removing pixel trackers, and a media proxy. It integrates with many bookmarking and read-later services, supports Fever and Google Reader APIs for mobile apps, and provides a REST API.
use_cases: read news feeds in one place
read blogs and podcasts from feeds
notable: Single statically compiled Go binary with static files embedded via the embed package
Privacy features: tracker and tracking-parameter removal, media proxy, youtube-nocookie embeds
Compatibility with Fever and Google Reader APIs for existing mobile apps
25+ third-party integrations including Wallabag, Readeck, Pinboard and Ntfy
Official Debian/RPM packages, pre-built binaries, and Docker images with ARM and RISC-V support
caveats: Opinionated, minimalist design may not suit users wanting many extra features
